candidates.extract: Metrocentre (previously styled as MetroCentre) is a shopping centre and entertainment complex in the Dunston area of Gateshead. It is located on the former site of Dunston Power Station, near to the River Tyne.

Dunston F.C.
candidates.extract: Dunston Football Club is a football club based in the Dunston area of Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England. They are currently members of the and play at the UTS Stadium.

candidates.name: Derwent Tower
candidates.description: Demolished apartment building in Dunston, England
candidates.extract: Derwent Tower was a 29-storey residential apartment building in Dunston, Tyne and Wear, United Kingdom. It was opened in 1972.

candidates.name: MetroCentre Interchange
candidates.extract: Metrocentre Interchange serves the Metrocentre in Gateshead. The bus station was originally constructed in the late 1980s, opened in 1987.

candidates.name: Redheugh Park
candidates.extract: Redheugh Park (pronounced red-yuff) was a football stadium in Gateshead, England. The stadium was built in 1930 when South Shields F.C. moved to Gateshead from Horsley Hill and became Gateshead AFC.

candidates.name: Kings Meadow Island
candidates.description: Former island on the River Tyne, England
candidates.extract: Kings Meadow Island (alternatively King's Meadow Island, or Kingsmeadow Island) was a flat island in the River Tyne in Northumberland, between Elswick on the north bank and Dunston on the south, near Gateshead, England. A smaller island, Little Annie lay nearby to the southwest whilst the two Clarenee Islands lay to the north of the east end of Kings Meadow.

candidates.name: River Team
candidates.extract: The River Team is a tributary of the River Tyne in Gateshead, England.

candidates.name: Dunston, Tyne and Wear
candidates.description: Area of Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England
candidates.extract: Dunston is a western area of the town of Gateshead on the south bank of the River Tyne, in the Metropolitan Borough of Gateshead, North East England (into which it was absorbed in 1974). Dunston had a population of 18,326 at the 2011 Census.

candidates.name: Kingsmeadow Community Comprehensive School
candidates.description: Community school in Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England
candidates.extract: Kingsmeadow Community Comprehensive School is a coeducational secondary school and sixth form based in Dunston, Metropolitan Borough of Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England. It was opened in 1990 on the site of Dunston Comprehensive School, combining the existing Saltwell Senior High, Dunston Comprehensive and Hillhead Junior High schools.

candidates.name: MetroCentre railway station
candidates.description: Railway station in Tyne and Wear, England
candidates.extract: MetroCentre is a railway station on the Tyne Valley Line, which runs between and via . The station, situated 3 mi west of Newcastle, between Dunston and Blaydon, serving the MetroCentre shopping centre, Gateshead in Tyne and Wear, England.

Angel of the North
candidates.description: Sculpture by Antony Gormley in northern England
candidates.extract: The Angel of the North is a contemporary sculpture by Antony Gormley, located in Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England. Completed in 1998, it is seen by an estimated 33 million people every year due to its proximity to the A1 and A167 roads and the East Coast Main Line.

candidates.name: Low Fell
candidates.extract: Low Fell is a suburb of Gateshead situated in the Metropolitan Borough of Gateshead in Tyne and Wear, England. Built predominantly on sandstone, grindstone and clay, it is bordered by Sheriff Hill/Deckham to the east, Saltwell/Bensham to the west, Harlow Green to the south and Shipcote to the north.

candidates.name: Pelaw Grange
candidates.extract: Pelaw Grange Stadium (known as Star Pelaw for sponsorship purposes) is a Greyhound Board of Great Britain regulated greyhound racing track located at North Lodge in the English county of Durham, between Chester-le-Street and Gateshead. The stadium has a restaurant and a number of bars and is owned by Star Sports.

Birtley Town F.C.
candidates.extract: Birtley Town Football Club is a football club based in Birtley, Tyne and Wear, England. They are currently members of the and play at the Birtley Sports Complex.

candidates.name: Grace College, Gateshead
candidates.description: Academy converter school in Gateshead, Tyne and Wear, England
candidates.extract: Grace College (formerly Joseph Swan Academy) is an academy converter with a sixth form located in Gateshead, England. The school is part of the Emmanuel Schools Foundation (ESF).

candidates.name: Derwent Tower
candidates.description: Demolished apartment building in Dunston, England
candidates.extract: Derwent Tower was a 29-storey residential apartment building in Dunston, Tyne and Wear, United Kingdom. It was opened in 1972.

candidates.name: Concangis
candidates.description: Roman fort in Co. Durham, England
candidates.extract: Concangis was an auxiliary castra in the Roman province of Lower Britain (Britannia Inferior). Its ruins are located in Chester-le-Street, County Durham, in England, and are now known as Chester-le-Street Roman Fort.
